asset_ownership_interpretation: Official statements and regulatory notices distinguish ordinary exchange-wallet assets from assets transferred into ZipUp and ZipUp+, which were placed through external lending platforms. Treatment may also depend on the contracting Zipmex entity and jurisdiction.
affected_product: ZipUp, ZipUp+, Z Wallet and exchange balances
notes: Product-dependent classification is used because the reviewed sources show different operational and counterparty paths for yield balances and ordinary exchange assets. The court materials do not establish one universal ownership or priority rule for every creditor class.
